ideas.pitch: An AI-powered diagnostic and triage assistant designed for rural clinics in Chhattisgarh with intermittent connectivity, utilizing edge AI and local language translation.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access
ideas.title: ArogyaMesh: Offline-First Rural Health Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the HealthTech track with a hyper-local, practical solution for Chhattisgarh's rural healthcare needs, making it deeply relevant to state-level judges.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and RAG pipeline that helps document, verify, and cross-reference indigenous medicinal plants and traditional remedies used by tribal communities in Chhattisgarh.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access
ideas.title: Vananchal Swasthya: Tribal Herbal Medicine Digitizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge RAG architecture with regional cultural heritage, scoring high on local relevance and technical execution.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first platform providing immutable provenance tracking and digital certificates for traditional Dhokra and iron craft artisans in Bastar.
ideas.title: BastarArt Authenticator: Blockchain-Backed Craft Provenance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the local identity of Chhattisgarh (Bastar art) to appeal directly to the state qualifier judges looking for regional socio-economic impact.

ideas.pitch: A predictive dashboard using machine learning and sensor inputs to forecast groundwater contamination risks across districts in Chhattisgarh.
ideas.title: JalSuraksha: Rural Water Quality & Contamination Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven data-forecasting pattern seen in winning infrastructure and resource-monitoring hacks, presenting clear, quantifiable public health benefits.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven career guidance and skill-gap analyzer tailored for rural students in Chhattisgarh, supporting Hindi and Chhattisgarhi dialects for resume-building and job matching.
ideas.title: ShikshaSetu: Multilingual Vocational Skill Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles employment and education accessibility with localized language support, impressing judges with direct socio-economic utility for students.
